text: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya #1 ma. paṭisallāne . yu. paṭisallānaṃ . evamuparipi . 2 yu. yaṃpi . bhavissati . rūpā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti . cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . cakkhusamphasso na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ
